ALTER TABLE fulfillment_members ADD COLUMN supplier_role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'production'

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_invites (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL, supplier_role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE, expires_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, accepted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, revoked_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, issued_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, INDEX (supplier_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_print_specs (supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, print_width_mm SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, print_height_mm SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, bleed_mm SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, min_dpi SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (supplier_id,category))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_preflight (order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, snapshot_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, report_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL, approved_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, approved_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_qc_evidence (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, upload_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', submitted_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, reviewed_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, review_note VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, reviewed_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, INDEX (order_id,line_id,status))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_issues (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', note VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, resolution VARCHAR(1000) NULL, created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, resolved_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, resolved_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, INDEX (order_id,status,created_at))
